task.pr_title: ci: least-privilege permissions on spellcheck (read) and stale-issues (job-level write for actions/stale)

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: Hey @arpitjain099, for this action cursor bot is right - the action doesn't need to read the contents, it needs to be able to read and write the issues and pull-requests objects and additionally for the internal action operations, it also needs to have `actions:write`.
